text:
Theo Barnes: Morning team  first day remote from London! Laptop arrived but Im blocked on SSH to the jumpbox: `Permission denied (publickey)`. Also: whos my buddy/mentor, and how do I get a visitor badge if I drop by SF? Fun fact: I play sax and bake sourdough.
Maya Patel: Welcome Theo!! :tada: Im your onboarding lead, and Devon will be your buddy. Badge pickup in SF is Lobby A 9-5 (bring photo ID). If remote we ship a temporary sticker, DM me your address. Added you to #new-hires and #ml-infra.
Devon Li: Hey Theo  nice to meet you. For SSH try:
```
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh -v tbarnes@jump.redwood.internal
```
Also make sure your public key is uploaded to GitLab (Profile > SSH Keys). If youre on Windows use Git Bash.
it-bot: Reminder: VPN and internal hosts require CompanyMDM enrollment before access is granted.
mdm-bot: To enroll: download CompanyMDM (mac dmg / win exe), open, sign in with @redwood.com and enter the emailed code. Wait ~5-10m for policies. Reply "enrolled" when finished.
Theo Barnes: Thanks  running `ssh-add` now and installing MDM next. Quick timezone note: Im GMT, so async onboarding is preferred.
Devon Li: Totally fine, we do async-first. Ill share notes and a quick Loom for the repo setup. We usually do a voluntary intro lunch on Fridays 12pm PT (recorded).
infra-bot: If SSH still fails after MDM, open an infra ticket and include `ssh -v` output (mask hostnames). Also confirm the key fingerprint you uploaded.
Theo Barnes: Enrolled and re-ran `ssh -v`  still permission denied. Sending the output to Devon in a DM. Appreciate the speedy help! Also: sourdough samples promised when Im in SF  consider yourselves warned :bread: :saxophone:
